verified_facts.text: Tower's rooms and suites have warm wood accents and views of the Atlantic Ocean and the South Florida coastline.
verified_facts.excerpt: featuring artful touches, warm wood accents, and stunning views of the Atlantic Ocean and South Florida coastline

verified_facts.text: Built-in window seating in Tower's rooms emphasizes the views, with warm wood accents and Floridian-inspired artwork.
verified_facts.excerpt: Built-in window seating emphasizes the spectacular views, while warm wood accents and Floridian-inspired artwork evoke a breezy, casual luxury.

verified_facts.text: Tower was designed by Rockwell Group, with a coastal theme, custom palm leaf-inspired carpets and warm wood accents.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Tower was designed by Rockwell Group, and the all-suite rooms feature a coastal theme, complete with custom palm leaf-inspired carpets and warm wood accents.

verified_facts.text: Tower's all-suite floors can be configured to guests' needs, from grouping connecting suites to taking over an entire floor, for groups and families.
verified_facts.excerpt: Whether grouping connecting suites or taking over the entire floor, Tower offers completely customizable stays that are ideal for groups and families.

verified_facts.text: Tower is steps away from Harborside's restaurants and Harborside Pool Club.
